messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — need to lock a time for the interface handoff/design review for the new API + SDK + Console props. Root ask is: review API surface changes, SDK auth flow, and console UX for route creation. Prefer 60m. Who's available this week?
Samir Patel: I'm free Wed 10–11am or Thu 2–3pm PT. Prefer Wed.
Jon Waller: Wed afternoon blocked for me. Thu 2pm works.
Lee Gomez: Thu 2pm PT is ok. Can we do 45m if we trim the agenda?
Priya Rao: Thu 2 works for me. I can trim to 45m if we keep the canary/rollback plan for follow-up.
Maria Chen: OK, tentatively Thu 2–2:45pm PT. Agenda draft:
- 5m quick context (Maria)
- 15m API surface walk-through (Samir)
- 10m SDK auth flow + code snippets (Jon)
- 10m Console UX for route creation + questions (Lee)
- 5m rollout/next steps + owners (Priya)
Samir Patel: I'll attach a short pre-read with API proto changes. TL;DR: we add a 'routing' field and optional 'cache_hint'. Please skim the example request/response.
Jon Waller: I'll add the SDK auth sample and a small snippet showing `CredentialProvider` changes. Will call out compatibility notes for 2.x clients.
Lee Gomez: I'll upload hi-fi mocks and a short interaction gif. Ask: do we want to surface the 'advanced options' inline or via an expand modal? I'd like feedback during the review.
Priya Rao: Also add a checklist item for security review: "Ensure KMS scopes on private deployments" — I'll add to pre-read.
Maria Chen: Action items before Thu:
- Samir: API pre-read (proto + example) — by Wed EOD
- Jon: SDK snippet + compatibility notes — by Wed EOD
- Lee: Console mocks + proposed UX copy — by Wed EOD
- Priya: Security checklist blurb — by Wed EOD
- All: add any must-discuss items to the doc inline
Samir Patel: Noted. I'll also include perf expectations: p95 token latency targets and suggested batching knob defaults.
Jon Waller: Will add a short migration guide section. Also tagging @deploy-bot to schedule the calendar invite.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created for Thu 02:00 PM PT — shared with participants.ics link
Lee Gomez: Thanks. Small ask: can we reserve the last 10 minutes for compatibility questions? We may need a follow-up deep-dive.
Maria Chen: Yes — I'll reflow agenda to ensure compatibility Qs aren't squeezed. If we need, we can schedule a follow-up focused on rollout/testing.
Priya Rao: FYI — I'll run through the KMS/HSM mapping with infra afterwards; might affect rollout timing.
Samir Patel: One more ask: reviewers from product/metrics — @Priya could you ping @Nina (product) and @Arjun (metrics) to join or drop notes in pre-read?
Priya Rao: Will do, pinged them in the doc comments.
Jon Waller: Okay, I'm set. If anyone can't make Thu 2, shout now so we can re-schedule.
Lee Gomez: All good from me.
Samir Patel: Good.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — final pre-read links and invite should be in the thread by Wed morning. See you Thu. :thumbsup:
